cycle_agreement.definition: per-case Lin CCC (ln(max(y,floor)) for TAWSS), median relative error |pred-true|/max(true,floor) and share within tolerance, top-10% Dice, threshold-mask Dice with true/pred area shares, semantic-segment mean relative error (segments with >= min points); case-level Bland-Altman (bias, 95% LoA) of the case mean (relative) and of mask area shares (absolute); segments keyed by wss_v5 SEMANTIC_LABELS id

per-case Lin CCC (linear for OSI), median relative error |pred-true|/max(true,floor) and share within tolerance, top-10% Dice, threshold-mask Dice with true/pred area shares, semantic-segment mean relative error (segments with >= min points); case-level Bland-Altman (bias, 95% LoA) of the case mean (relative) and of mask area shares (absolute); segments keyed by wss_v5 SEMANTIC_LABELS id

multi_target.definition: one forward pass, out_dim=3; channel 0 = peak-frame WSS (log_z, comparable with X5D), heads = TAWSS (log_z) and OSI (stats method of the multi file); equal-weight channel MSE
